comparison.objective: Sort objects on a belt whose speed surges, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Classification and speed-adaptive conveyor picking differ from recessed tool engagement, fine rotary tuning, counterholding, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct sorting under belt-speed changes differs from repeated safe stopping and retained damper setting. Record has no specs or accuracy threshold.
comparison.reason: The record tests adaptive sorting, not mechanical adjustment or energy absorption.
